===  Notes ===

* '''iu cu'i''' was removed from the list because the keyword "no love lost" was too confusing, its meaning is fairly obvious anyway, and no usage was found.

* '''.u'u cu'i''' and '''.u'u nai''' were interchanged.

===  Section Issues ===

* [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban/browse_thread/thread/dc6bb04a6f9167f3 he realis/irrealis distinction] has been rather hotly debated over the years. It is my ( Lindar ) opinion that the reality/irreality of the UI is dependent upon the reality/irreality of the jufra, and can be indicated with da'i/da'inai or some other kind of marker. This way ''ni'o .a'o mi klama'' can mean ''I hope I go.'' in one instance and ''I'm going, about which I feel hopeful.'' for another, rather than being restricted to one meaning.

* [https://groups.google.com/group/lojban/tree/browse_frm/month/2005-05/85f8b775047c0d5c?rnum=21&amp;_done=%2Fgroup%2Flojban%2Fbrowse_frm%2Fmonth%2F2005-05%3F#doc_85f8b775047c0d5c he +nai meanings could use some review and cementing.]]
